description: This crossword explores the social, economic and political conditions of Cuba in 1958, highlighting problems such as discrimination, unemployment, corruption and exploitation that led to the assault on the Moncada Barracks in 1953 and the triumph of the Revolution in 1959. Through key words, aspects such as the exclusion of vulnerable groups, economic dependence on the United States and inequalities in health, education and housing are examined.
help:
HELP – HOW TO USE THE SAMM CROSSWORD PROGRAM
=============================================

This program (index.html) runs entirely in your browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari up to date recommended). It requires no installation, no permanent connection and no special permissions. It only needs a data file with a .json extension to build the crossword.

On the other hand, if you are using the Android APK, everything described here works the same way.

---------------------------------------------------------------------
1) LOADING A CROSSWORD
---------------------------------------------------------------------
There are three equivalent ways:

  a) "Select file" (browse button):
     Click and choose an xxx.json file on your device (for example
     CubaBrio.1492.1.json). The crossword will be drawn instantly.

  b) "Load from URL":
     Paste the full address of the .json into the text box
     (https://.../CubaBrio.1492.1.json) and click "Load from URL".
     If the server does not allow CORS, you will see a warning; in that
     case, download the file and use way (a).

  c) "Browse URL":
     Paste the address of a directory (it must end in "/") and
     click "Browse URL". The .json files found will be listed and you
     can "Choose" (paste the path) or "Load" the one you want directly.

When any crossword is loaded, the buttons Introduction, Description,
Help, Tips & Tricks, Save Progress, Load Progress, Reveal Word,
Reveal Letter and Show Solution are automatically activated.

---------------------------------------------------------------------
2) FILLING IN THE CROSSWORD
---------------------------------------------------------------------
• Click on any white square to select it.
• Type the letter. The cursor automatically jumps to the next square
  of the current word (auto-jump). You can also type the whole word
  straight through without worrying about the jump.
• The comparison IGNORES ACCENTS and the Ñ (Á = A, Ñ = N, Ü = U).
  Type with or without an accent mark: the program accepts it either way.
• Backspace deletes the letter and moves back one square.
  Delete deletes without moving back.
• The arrows ← ↑ → ↓ move the selection.
• Right-clicking on a square shows, in a small window, the clue or
  clues associated with that square (horizontal, vertical, or both if
  the square is an intersection).
• The complete clues, numbered and separated into across and down,
  always appear on the right (or below on mobile).

---------------------------------------------------------------------
3) HELP DURING THE GAME
---------------------------------------------------------------------
• "Reveal Word": fills in all the letters of the word where the
  cursor is located.
• "Reveal Letter": fills in the first empty letter of the selected
  word (only one per press).
• "Show Solution": fills in the entire crossword. It asks for
  confirmation to prevent accidents.

The cells color themselves: green if the letter is correct, red if it
is incorrect. When you delete a letter, the color disappears.

---------------------------------------------------------------------
4) SAVING AND LOADING PROGRESS
---------------------------------------------------------------------
• "Save Progress": downloads a .json file to your device with the
  current state (letters written, words and texts of the crossword).
  You can change the suggested name before accepting.

  IMPORTANT ABOUT WHERE IT IS SAVED:
  The program cannot choose the destination folder: that is always
  decided by the browser or the operating system for security reasons.
  In most configurations, the file will appear in the device's
  DOWNLOADS folder. If the option "Ask where to save each file before
  downloading" is enabled in your browser, the "Save as…" dialog will
  appear and you can choose another folder (Documents, Desktop, USB
  drive, etc.). Therefore: if you do not move it, look for it in
  Downloads; if you saved it in another folder, remember it for when
  you want to load it.

  NOTE FOR ANDROID:
  On an Android phone or tablet the system does NOT allow choosing a
  folder: the file is always saved in "Downloads". Furthermore, the
  app that displays this crossword (WebView) may not complete the
  download due to security limitations. That is why, when you press
  "Save Progress" on Android, a BACKUP window will ALWAYS open with
  the complete progress text in .json format, with two buttons:
     - "Copy to clipboard": copy the text, open the "Files" app
       (or any text editor on the device), create a new file, paste it
       and save it with a .json extension (for example:
       CubaBrio.1492.1_progress.json).
     - "Retry download": tries the automatic download again.
  We advise using file names WITHOUT accents or Ñ (for example
  CubaBrio instead of CubaBrío), because some Android download
  managers fail with special characters. The program already
  suggests a name without accents and, if you type any, it
  converts it automatically.

• "Load Progress": IMPORTANT → you must first reload the original
  crossword (the same .json you started with) and only then press
  "Load Progress" and choose the saved file. Only in this way is
  everything restored to the exact point where you left it.

  When the program asks you to "select" the progress file, the
  system file selector will open. This selector usually opens in the
  last used folder or in Downloads, but you can freely navigate to
  where you saved the file. Look for the name you gave it when saving
  (for example: CubaBrio.1492.1_progress.json). If you left it in
  Downloads, it will appear there; if you moved it, look for it in its
  new location. On Android, open it from the "Files" app.

---------------------------------------------------------------------
5) INFORMATION BUTTONS
---------------------------------------------------------------------
• "Introduction": overall meaning of SAMM's Consciousness Crosswords
  (the complete project, its philosophy and its purpose).
• "Description": particular summary of the crossword you have loaded.
• "Help": this same text.
• "Tips & Tricks": recommendations on strategy, interpretation and
  didactic use of the clues.

---------------------------------------------------------------------
6) IF SOMETHING DOES NOT WORK
---------------------------------------------------------------------
• The crossword is not drawn? Check that the .json has the fields
  "size", "grid" and "placed". If the browser downloaded it as .txt,
  rename it to .json.
• Does it not load from URL? It is usually CORS. Download the .json
  and load it locally with "Select file".
• Did everything get erased when you reloaded the page? That is
  normal: the browser does not save state. Use "Save Progress" before
  closing.
• Can't find the progress file you saved? Look for it first in the
  DOWNLOADS folder. On Android, open it from the "Files" app. If the
  option "Ask where to save each file" is enabled in your browser,
  you may have saved it in another folder: remember which one you
  chose. If it does not appear on Android, press "Save Progress"
  again and use the "Copy to clipboard" button in the backup window.
• Accented letters not accepted? Type without the accent; the system
  normalizes them and considers them correct.

Enjoy, investigate, read, learn!

Thank you very much for selecting us… SAMM.
introduction:
SAMM's Consciousness Crosswords: a journey to discover, reflect and connect with Cuban history (as a colony, neocolony and independent developing country).

Are you passionate about challenges that go beyond the surface? These crosswords are not a simple pastime: they are an invitation to explore, analyze and connect historical, cultural and social facts that have shaped Cuba. Here, each word is a piece of a larger puzzle, designed to stimulate your curiosity, strengthen your critical thinking and encourage you to discover connections between the past, the present and the future.

How do they work?

Each crossword is a window to deep themes. You will find clues that require interpretation, analysis and, sometimes, research. It is not about quick answers, but about reflections that will lead you to:
- Discover historical background and its impact on the present.
- Relate seemingly distant events, but united by a common thread.
- Formulate hypotheses based on verifiable facts.
- Debate ideas and build your own conclusions.

Examples of approaches to some themes:
1. Cuban resistance: From 1492 with Hatuey to today, the struggle for freedom has not been a linear path. Each generation has added its courage to defend what was won.
2. Power in the shadows: How is the influence of elites maintained in opposing systems? The political history of relations with Cuba of the colonizers and after true independence in 1959 offers revealing keys.

Who is this challenge for?
- For those who enjoy learning actively, combining curiosity and rigor.
- For minds that see in every detail an opportunity to question, investigate and grow.
- For those who believe that knowledge has no temporal borders and that understanding yesterday is key to transforming tomorrow.

Your role:
We do not seek perfect answers, but minds willing to explore. If you like:
- Training your brain
- Reading between the lines.
- Connecting ideas.
- Defending your arguments with solid bases.
… this is your space!

At the end:
We hope that this crossword has not only challenged your mind, but also ignited a spark of curiosity to follow the "historical thread" in other SAMM crosswords and to investigate, study, analyze, debate, conclude and dream of an informed future.
Thank you very much for selecting us...

SAMM.
tipstricks:
TIPS & TRICKS – HOW TO MAKE THE MOST OF SAMM'S CROSSWORDS
==========================================================

These crosswords are not a simple pastime: they are a journey through
the "historical thread" of Cuba (colony, neocolony and independent
developing country). The key word is just an excuse: what matters is
reading, reflection and the connections you discover between dates,
events and protagonists.

---------------------------------------------------------------------
1) THE "HISTORICAL THREAD" IS THE KEY
---------------------------------------------------------------------
• Each clue is linked to a specific year or period.
  Always pay attention to the dates: 1492, 1512, 1533, 1762, 1793, 1810,
  1812, 1841, 1868, 1886, 1895, 1898, 1930, 1953, 1959, 1961, 1991,
  2009, 2019…
• These dates are repeated between crosswords. Comparing them
  will reveal patterns of continuity (for example, repression,
  resistance, foreign interference, solidarity).
• All the puzzles (stories) that contain more than one date are
  repeated in the crosswords of those periods. If when looking for a
  date you do not find its copy in the corresponding crossword, it is
  a sign that this story was written after the .json you have loaded;
  in that case, look in the context of the latter for its impact or
  its association with the previous story.
• When a clue seems "strange", do not read it as an isolated phrase:
  read it as a link in a historical chain.

---------------------------------------------------------------------
2) DO NOT LOOK FOR PURE GRAMMAR
---------------------------------------------------------------------
• To save space in the grid, the editor does not use literary
  syntax. Condensed phrases, synonyms, anacolutha, quotation marks
  and underscores abound, or not.
• The underscore with spaces "_ _ _ _ _" indicates the letters or
  words you must fill in. In contrast, the short line "____" (without
  spaces) is not a space to fill in: it is an editing resource. It is
  clearly distinguished by observing the grid and the number of
  letters required by the square.
• When a question such as what?, how?, who?, where?, etc. appears in
  the clue, the answer is always the word that must occupy that place
  within the sentence or story; it is not a rhetorical question or an
  adornment of the text.
• Many clues are intentionally long: they do not describe the word,
  they place it in a context. The word appears as the conclusion of
  the reasoning, not as a direct definition.

---------------------------------------------------------------------
3) KEY WORDS ARE RELATIVE
---------------------------------------------------------------------
• Here key words take a back seat. It does not matter so much
  "getting the word right" as understanding why that word is in that
  place and what role it plays in the story.
• Once you have filled in the crossword, read the clues again: many
  acquire full meaning only at the end.
• Write down new terms separately and verify them. The clue usually
  points to verifiable historical sources.

---------------------------------------------------------------------
4) SOLVING STRATEGY
---------------------------------------------------------------------
• Start with the shortest clues (3–5 letters): they are usually at
  intersections and will open up the long words for you.
• Use right-click on crossing squares: you will see both clues
  (horizontal and vertical) at the same time. It is the fastest way
  to advance in blocked areas.
• Take advantage of auto-jump: when you type a letter, the cursor
  jumps by itself. If you already have a clear hypothesis, type the
  whole word straight through.
• Use "Reveal Letter" before "Reveal Word": a single correct letter
  at an intersection usually unlocks the whole area.
• Leave "Show Solution" as a last resort: use it to check, not to
  start. The complete solution is meant as a final verification of
  learning.

---------------------------------------------------------------------
5) DIDACTIC USE (for teachers and self-learners)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
• Print or project the crossword and work on it in a group: each
  word can be the start of an investigation.
• Ask the student to locate the date cited in the clue and look for
  another source that confirms or nuances it.
• Use the Introduction and Description buttons as the framework for
  the activity: the first gives the global purpose, the second the
  specific theme of the loaded crossword.
• After solving, encourage a debate: "what repeats in Cuban history
  between 1492 and today?", "what changed with 1959?".

---------------------------------------------------------------------
6) ETHICS OF THE GAME
---------------------------------------------------------------------
• Verify, check and contrast. Do not take a fact as good just
  because it fits the grid.
• Question, discuss, propose. The goal is not to repeat what the
  clue says, but to learn to think historically.
• Remember: knowledge has no temporal borders and understanding
  yesterday is key to transforming tomorrow.

---------------------------------------------------------------------
7) PRACTICAL REMINDER
---------------------------------------------------------------------
• Save your progress often: "Save Progress".
• Before "Load Progress", reload the original .json of the
  crossword; only then is everything restored exactly where you left
  it.
• If an accented letter or Ñ is not accepted, type it without the
  accent: the program normalizes (Á = A, Ñ = N, Ü = U) and will
  consider it correct.

Enjoy, investigate, read, learn!

Thank you very much for selecting us… SAMM.
